label_rule: AND of private approval values over the private required ancestor closure, including anchor
normal_approval_rule: all required records true; distractor approval bits independent Bernoulli(0.5), shared across paired label views
violation_approval_rule: one uniformly chosen required nonanchor false; other required records true; same distractor approval bits as normal view
fault_rule: exactly one anchor parent slot changed; true DAG, required set, approvals and declared arity unchanged
frontier_order: breadth first by discovered depth, ascending opaque ID within a depth
frontier_fallback: one final batch of smallest unread opaque IDs; never expand fallback payloads
frontier_uses: already read payload IDs, declared arity and parent slots
identity_randomization: private 256-bit key sampled once per split before generation; domain-separated HMAC-SHA256 opaque 128-bit IDs, without replacement by collision-fail policy
primary_contrast: pointer_frontier_bfs AND-fork/join minus chain complete recovery, at each fixed k/budget/condition; average two label views within family
negative_control_contrast: blind_id_batch AND-fork/join minus chain at each k/budget/condition
secondary_method_contrast: pointer_frontier_bfs minus blind_id_batch, at each topology/k/budget/condition
independent_unit: fresh seed family; all topology, k, budget, fault and label views remain clustered
bootstrap_family_indices: one shared saved 2000-by-96 matrix for all 72 contrasts; Python random.Random seeded by integer SHA256 of UTF-8 SWARM-018-topology-v1|family-bootstrap
multiplicity_adjustment: none; descriptive conditional intervals, no significance-based method selection
private_stream_encoding: ASCII compact canonical JSON array [protocol, split, family_seed, k, namespace, ...parts]
random_choice_rule: random.Random(big-endian integer HMAC-SHA256 digest).randrange(number_of_choices), one independent stream per namespace
analytic_completion_checks: Frozen combinatorial expectations for blind and complete-frontier-then-fallback; theoretical, not observed rates
development_bootstrap: Same fixed hash seed, 2000 rows, 6 family indices per row via randrange(6); never use evaluation families
distractor_structure: disjoint four-record AND diamonds: root, two one-parent branches, two-parent join; (32-k)/4 components
false_leaf_target_rule: uniform among distractor component roots, independent of their approval and the true label
